task.description:
Implement OIDC-10 (Attribute Synchronisation) per the design in src/design/oidc-10-attribute-sync.md.

1. Replace the stub syncAttributesFromIdentityContext in src/oidc/jit_provisioning.zig with a real implementation:
   - Resolve the user by external identity (tenant_id, realm, sub)
   - Compare current stored profile fields (display_name, email, status) against token claims
   - If changed, call identity_service to update profile fields
   - Return the updated User record with a SyncResult indicating profile_changed and role diff

2. Implement role reconciliation:
   - Define a reconcileRoles function that takes token roles and current user role bindings
   - Partition existing bindings into OIDC-sourced vs locally-assigned (using role_source column)
   - Compute add_set = token_roles \ (oidc_slugs ∪ local_slugs); these are roles missing from both sources
   - Compute remove_set = oidc_slugs \ token_roles; these are OIDC-sourced roles no longer in the token
   - Insert/delete only OIDC-sourced bindings; locally-assigned roles are preserved
   - Return the diff (roles_added, roles_removed)

3. Create migration file for the role_source column:
   - ALTER TABLE user_roles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal'
   - COMMENT on column: "'oidc' = sourced from OIDC token claims and subject to reconciliation; 'internal' = assigned locally via IDN-03, preserved across reconciliation"

4. Wire into the auth pipeline (auth.zig):
   - After JIT provisioning (processProvisionResult), call syncAttributesFromIdentityContext
   - If sync fails, log a warning but do NOT block auth
   - After sync, reload role bindings (since reconciliation may have changed them)

5. Validate:
   - zig build exits 0
   - zig build test exits 0 (unit tests)
   - Error-set validation (zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" must produce no output)

6. Commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc10-20260527
acceptance_criteria: reconcileRoles function correctly preserves locally-assigned roles
Migration adds role_source column to user_roles
zig build exits 0 with no error-set warnings
All changes committed and pushed to feature/WF02-oidc10-20260527

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-10 attribute sync and role reconciliation: replaced stub in jit_provisioning.zig with full syncAttributesFromIdentityContext (profile update, role reconciliation via pool queries), added registry functions (updateUserProfile, selectUserRoles, insertOidcRoleBinding, deleteOidcRoleBinding), added service functions (updateOidcUserProfile, reconcileOidcRoles), created migration 040_oidc10_role_source.sql, wired sync into auth.zig via callback pattern. zig build exits 0, zig build test passes, no error set warnings.
